hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom curve hook enabling 1:1 swaps between ETH and phiEth (an ETH-wrapping token). In beforeSwap, it takes input from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit or phiEth.withdraw, settles output, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta that bypasses the AMM entirely. Direct liquidity additions are blocked via beforeAddLiquidity.
